prompt: A photograph of a bedroom wall painted a soft warm grey-blue, shot STRAIGHT ON: the camera faces the wall square, the wall fills the whole picture, no second wall, no ceiling and no corner of the room is visible, and there is NO perspective — the wall is flat and parallel to the camera. THE INSIDE OF THE FRAME IS COMPLETELY EMPTY — a flat, even, pure BLACK rectangle: no picture, no pattern, no photograph, no text, no glare and no reflection, unobstructed from edge to edge. NOT a diptych, NOT a split screen, NOT a collage, NOT a before-and-after, NOT two or more panels stacked or side by side. There is no dividing line, no seam, no border and no gutter anywhere in the picture. Shot on a phone by a parent, not by a photographer: available light, no studio lighting, no flash, slight imperfection. Square 1:1. No text overlay, no caption, no watermark. No readable words on signage, boards, banners or clothing — the playing surface's own painted markings are fine and expected.
